name: DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B-it
description: Google DeepMind's block-diffusion LM on the Gemma 4 26B-A4B backbone (DiffusionGemmaForBlockDiffusion): one set of 30 MoE layers ([5 × sliding-window 1024, 1 × global] pattern, every layer a dense MLP plus top-8 of 128 experts) is run causally as an encoder to cache the prompt, then bidirectionally as a decoder that denoises 256-token canvases from uniform random ids in up to 48 steps, with self-conditioning on the previous step's logits and an entropy-bound sampler. 27-layer ViT for images. Numbers from config.json, generation_config.json and the safetensors headers.

summary.note: Every tensor in the checkpoint (incl. MTP / draft and vision weights), summed from the safetensors headers.

Weights multiplied per text token by the main model: lm head included; embedding (a row lookup), MTP / draft heads and vision / audio encoders excluded. Counted per canvas token per denoising step; includes the always-on dense MLP and the self-conditioning MLP. The lm head is tied to the embedding (0.74B, counted here as the head).

summary.value: SWA-1024 5 : 1 global, GQA 16 q / 8 kv × 256 (sliding) · 16 q / 2 kv × 512, K = V (global); bidirectional over the canvas
